meta.title: corepop – a colour puzzle with spaceships
meta.description: Launch your spaceships and take figures made of colourful blocks apart layer by layer – every ship only hits its own colour.

home.claim: Crack the core – colour by colour.
home.intro: Tap spaceships to send them into the hangar. Each ship only shoots blocks of its own colour. Plan ahead: the hangar has only a few bays.

game.hint: Tap a ship. It only shoots blocks of its own colour. Swipe to turn the figure.
game.lostText: No ship in the hangar can find a target of its colour.
game.noWebgl: Sorry, your browser cannot show 3D graphics.

about.title: About corepop
about.intro: corepop is a colour puzzle: your spaceships take block figures apart layer by layer. Every ship only hits its own colour.
about.privacy: No sign-up, no ads. Your progress stays on your device only.
about.openSource: corepop is built with great open-source projects. Thanks to everyone who contributes to them!
